summary: Unlock the secrets of successful construction project management. Enroll in our contract administration training and elevate your professional expertise today.
lede: Construction contract administration gives project managers, contract administrators, construction engineers, and site supervisors a structured way to manage project obligations. The course addresses the practical work of tracking deliverables, changes, time, payments, and documentation against contract requirements. Participants practise assessing extension-of-time claims, maintaining variation and payment records, developing inspection plans, managing disputes, and preparing performance reports and closeout documents.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who manage construction contracts and must deliver projects under budget and time constraints while maintaining full contractual compliance. It is designed for: Project Manager:
audience: Oversee contract delivery methods and phase integration
Contract Administrator: Manage documentation registers, RFIs
Construction Engineer: Apply contract clauses to resolve
Site Supervisor: Ensure on-site work aligns
Commercial Manager: Process payment claims, evaluate variations
Subcontractor Manager: Coordinate vendor performance and enforce
Quality Assurance Officer: Develop Inspection and Test
Risk Manager: Allocate project risks and develop
Procurement Specialist: Select vendors and manage subcontractor
Project Controls Engineer: Build performance dashboards
modules: Time Management and Extension of Time Claims
prerequisites: Prerequisites include working knowledge of construction project delivery methods (e.g., design-bid-build, design-build) and basic contract terminology. No coding or advanced software skills are required, but familiarity with MS Excel and collaboration tools is helpful. A brief pre-course reading guide on standard contract clauses (FIDIC, JCT) will be provided 7 days before the course.
